commit_message:
[DispatchCreation] Fix GatherFusionPattern on a scalar producer operand (#24803)

GatherFusionPattern builds a tensor.extract for every operand of the
producer generic, so a scalar operand reached cast<TensorType> and
asserted. A scalar is invariant over the iteration space, so there is no
index to permute and nothing to extract: the fused body reads the value
itself.

The producer has to be a bit extend or a transpose to qualify, and that
classification deliberately ignores non-tensor inputs, so a qualifying
producer can have them. A per-tensor dequantize widening i8 to f32 with
its scale passed as an f32 is one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Signed-off-by: default <ziereis@roofline.ai>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
Fix Python HAL device creation params only last one used

The `HalDriver::CreateDevice()` binding built `iree_string_pair_t`
entries pointing into `c_str()` of `std::string` objects stored in a
`std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>`. Because the vector
could reallocate during the loop, earlier `c_str()` pointers became
dangling, leading to only the last parameter being reliably visible to
`iree_hal_driver_create_device_by_id()`.

Reserve space in `param_strings` before the loop so that no reallocation
occurs while building the `iree_string_pair_t` array.

Signed-off-by: Shogo Yamazaki <pgp@mocknen.net>
name: pr-greeter
